description: A Python script for stock analysis that retrieves financial data from APIs and websites, calculates intrinsic value, and displays financial metrics for a specific stock (AAPL).

methods.name: json_data
methods.description: Fetches and parses JSON data from a URL.

methods.name: get_financial_statements
methods.description: Retrieves income statement, cash flow statement, and balance sheet data for the stock.

methods.name: get_finviz_data
methods.description: Scrapes financial metrics from Finviz for the stock.

methods.name: calc_intrinsic_value
methods.description: Calculates the intrinsic value of the stock based on financial data and growth assumptions.
